facts.value: Helpful tips for searching and applying can be found on the pages of the e-Career Service: [Domestic Internship](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/94784867/e_Career_Service)
If you already know that you want to do an internship and are specifically looking for positions, it is recommended to use the job placement service and the job offers listed on this page.

If you consider doing an internship abroad and want information and counseling, you can contact the representatives in the International Office as well as the student initiative AIESEC: [Global Office](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/38298690/internships) [AIESEC](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/42217190/AIESEC)

If you are looking for a working student position, a student job, a temporary project assignment, an internship, or an entry-level position and want to connect with companies, the job placement service of the Career Service at Goethe University can assist you: [Job Placement](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/94952374/Jobvermittlung)

You may find job offers of all kinds in the job boards of the Career Service or the Studentenwerk Frankfurt am Main: [Career Service: Jobs](https://stellenportal-uni-frankfurt.de/) [Studentenwerk Frankfurt: Jobs](http://stellenmarkt.studentenwerkfrankfurt.de/)

If you have legal questions about working during your studies, you can get information and advice from the Studentenwerk Frankfurt am Main: [Working During Studies](https://www.swffm.de/beratung-finanzierung/rechtsberatung)

If you want to apply as a student assistant in the Department of Economics, you can find all current job postings for HiWi and tutor positions here: [Jobs for HiWis and Tutors](http://www.wiwi.uni-frankfurt.de/hiwi-jobs)
If you are interested in pursuing a doctorate in the field of economics, you can find information about a doctorate in economics here: [Promotion in Economics](/studium/studienprogramme/promotion)
Current doctorate positions at Goethe University can be found here: [Goethe University: Doctorate Positions](https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/47551275/akademische_wissenschaftliche_mitarbeiter)
Current doctorate positions in the German-speaking region can be found on the pages of the Career Service: [Additional Doctorate Positions](https://stellenportal-uni-frankfurt.de/)
